about: Discord #30: GNX's scroll bar took every mouse press on its whole track, so a captive whose face sat under the bar (right edge, zoomed out) could not be dragged out of her cell. Only the thumb takes the mouse now. Fixture mid (a deep nest, so the bar shows).

steps.name: gnx_scn_scrollbar_takes
steps.why: control: the bar is drawn and its thumb takes the mouse
